editor.premise: Turn an oversized handmade flower into a field photoshoot, then find photographic stories in ordinary garden work.

chapters.name: Making Flower Parts
chapters.purpose: Introduce the idea through making, withholding the completed oversized flower.

chapters.name: Preparing The Stem
chapters.purpose: Move outdoors and build the support, with animal interruptions.

chapters.name: Assembling The Flower
chapters.purpose: Connect the separate components and reveal their unexpected scale.

chapters.name: Field Photoshoot
chapters.purpose: Reward the construction sequence with staged scenes and finished photographs.

chapters.name: Garden Work
chapters.purpose: Reset into everyday tasks, from collecting seeds to tending plants.

chapters.name: Photographing Everyday Life
chapters.purpose: Reframe ordinary gardening as material for photographs and reflection.

captions.note: Small bottom-centered diary sentences continue across several cuts; occasional short labels accompany photographs. Reading time comes from persistence, not long individual shots.

editor.notes: Compress repeated handwork into short inserts, but hold the assembled object and selected photographs longer. Alternate useful steps with animal detours. Use finished stills as local payoffs, and reserve soft transitions for larger changes of time or activity.
